  laplace : ℝ

namespace RouteERecurrenceKernel

variable {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [LinearOrder ι]

/-- Outgoing row mass. -/
def rowMass (K : RouteERecurrenceKernel ι) (i : ι) : ℝ :=
  ∑ j, K.transition i j

/-- Incoming column load. -/
def columnLoad (K : RouteERecurrenceKernel ι) (i : ι) : ℝ :=
  ∑ j, K.transition j i

/-- Symmetrized recurrence incidence. -/
def symmetricBase (K : RouteERecurrenceKernel ι) (i j : ι) : ℝ :=
  (K.transition i j + K.transition j i) / 2

theorem rowMass_nonneg (K : RouteERecurrenceKernel ι) (i : ι) : 0 ≤ K.rowMass i :=
  Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _hj => K.transition_nonneg i j

theorem columnLoad_nonneg (K : RouteERecurrenceKernel ι) (i : ι) : 0 ≤ K.columnLoad i :=
  Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _hj => K.transition_nonneg j i

theorem transition_diag (K : RouteERecurrenceKernel ι) (i : ι) : K.transition i i = 0 := by
  by_contra hii
  have hflip := K.parity_reversing i i hii
  have hsign : K.sign i = 0 := by linarith
  have habs := K.sign_abs_one i

  norm_num at habs

  exact div_nonneg

  simp only [symmetricBase]

theorem complexMatrixRealification_zero :
    complexMatrixRealification (0 : Matrix m n ℂ) = 0 := by
  ext i j
  rcases i with i | i <;> rcases j with j | j <;>
    simp [complexMatrixRealification, complexMatrixRealPart,
      complexMatrixImagPart]

/-- Reversing complex orientation at both endpoints preserves every realified complex passage. -/
theorem complexMatrixRealification_joint_orientation_reversal
    [Fintype m] [DecidableEq m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (X : Matrix m n ℂ) :
    (-doubledRealComplexStructure (n := m)) * complexMatrixRealification X =
      complexMatrixRealification X * (-doubledRealComplexStructure (n := n)) := by
  have h := complexMatrixRealification_intertwines_complexStructure X
  simpa only [Matrix.neg_mul, Matrix.mul_neg] using congrArg Neg.neg h

/-- Reversing only target complex orientation is compatible exactly with the zero passage. -/
theorem complexMatrixRealification_target_orientation_reversal_iff_zero
    [Fintype m] [DecidableEq m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (X : Matrix m n ℂ) :
    doubledRealComplexStructure (n := m) * complexMatrixRealification X =
        complexMatrixRealification X * (-doubledRealComplexStructure (n := n)) ↔
      X = 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hneg :
        doubledRealComplexStructure (n := m) * complexMatrixRealification X =
          -(complexMatrixRealification X *
            doubledRealComplexStructure (n := n)) := by
      simpa only [Matrix.mul_neg] using h
    have hstandard :=
      complexMatrixRealification_intertwines_complexStructure X
    have hphase :
        complexMatrixRealification X * doubledRealComplexStructure (n := n) =
          -(complexMatrixRealification X *
            doubledRealComplexStructure (n := n)) :=
      hstandard.symm.trans hneg
    rw [realification_mul_doubledRealComplexStructure] at hphase
    ext i j
    apply Complex.ext
    · have hre := congrFun (congrFun hphase (Sum.inl i)) (Sum.inr j)
      simp [complexMatrixRealification, complexMatrixImagPart] at hre
      change (X i j).re = 0
      linarith
    · have him := congrFun (congrFun hphase (Sum.inl i)) (Sum.inl j)
      simp [complexMatrixRealification, complexMatrixRealPart] at him
      change (X i j).im = 0
      linarith
  · rintro rfl
    rw [complexMatrixRealification_zero, Matrix.mul_zero, Matrix.zero_mul]

theorem complexMatrixRealification_source_orientation_reversal_iff_zero
    [Fintype m] [DecidableEq m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (X : Matrix m n ℂ) :

  · rintro rfl
    rw [complexMatrixRealification_zero, Matrix.mul_zero, Matrix.zero_mul]

/-- **Orientation-reversing transport of differential algebraicity.**  An automorphism that
anti-commutes with the derivation preserves differential algebraicity exactly. -/
theorem differentialAlgebraicOver_map_iff (σ : AntiDifferentialAlgEquiv F E) (x : E) :
    DifferentialAlgebraicOver F (σ.toAlgEquiv x) ↔ DifferentialAlgebraicOver F x := by
  have hkey : ∀ y : E, AlgebraicIndependent F (fun p : Unit × ℕ => differentialJet p.2 y)
      ↔ AlgebraicIndependent F (fun p : Unit × ℕ => differentialJet p.2 (σ.toAlgEquiv y)) := by
    intro y
    have hsign : ∀ p : Unit × ℕ,
        σ.toAlgEquiv (differentialJet p.2 y)
          = (-1 : E) ^ p.2 * differentialJet p.2 (σ.toAlgEquiv y) :=
      fun p => σ.map_differentialJet p.2 y
    constructor
    · intro hind
      have himg : AlgebraicIndependent F
          (fun p : Unit × ℕ => σ.toAlgEquiv (differentialJet p.2 y)) :=
        hind.map (f := σ.toAlgEquiv.toAlgHom) σ.toAlgEquiv.injective.injOn
      have hrw : (fun p : Unit × ℕ => σ.toAlgEquiv (differentialJet p.2 y))
          = fun p : Unit × ℕ =>
            ((signUnit (F := F) p.2 : F)) • differentialJet p.2 (σ.toAlgEquiv y) := by
        funext p
        rw [hsign p, signUnit_smul]
      rw [hrw] at himg
      exact (algebraicIndependent_smul_units_iff
        (fun p : Unit × ℕ => signUnit (F := F) p.2) _).mp himg
    · intro hind
      have hscaled : AlgebraicIndependent F
          (fun p : Unit × ℕ => ((signUnit (F := F) p.2 : F)) •
            differentialJet p.2 (σ.toAlgEquiv y)) :=
        (algebraicIndependent_smul_units_iff
          (fun p : Unit × ℕ => signUnit (F := F) p.2) _).mpr hind
      have hrw : (fun p : Unit × ℕ =>
          ((signUnit (F := F) p.2 : F)) • differentialJet p.2 (σ.toAlgEquiv y))
            = ⇑σ.toAlgEquiv.toAlgHom ∘ fun p : Unit × ℕ => differentialJet p.2 y := by
        funext p
        show ((signUnit (F := F) p.2 : F)) • differentialJet p.2 (σ.toAlgEquiv y)
          = σ.toAlgEquiv (differentialJet p.2 y)
        rw [signUnit_smul, ← hsign p]
      rw [hrw] at hscaled
      exact hscaled.of_comp σ.toAlgEquiv.toAlgHom
  constructor
  · intro hs hx
    exact hs (by simpa [DifferentialIndependent] using (hkey x).mp (by simpa [DifferentialIndependent] using hx))
  · intro hx hs
    exact hx (by simpa [DifferentialIndependent] using (hkey x).mpr (by simpa [DifferentialIndependent] using hs))

end AntiDifferentialAlgEquiv

/-!
# Prime-orientation line of the Burnol affine gauge

The transverse coordinate of a two-prime Burnol synthesis is not an ordinary scalar under
permutation of the prime frame.  It is a determinant-line coordinate: reversing the frame reverses
the gauge sign.  With that sign, prime-swap covariance holds identically, including off the
critical line.

If the same raw source number is incorrectly retained after frame reversal, covariance becomes
equivalent to zero horizontal gauge and hence to RH.  The exact classification below separates a
genuine symmetry law from a false scalar-naturalness producer.  It prevents prime-label symmetry
from hiding the desired conclusion and identifies the correct oriented home of the surviving
source class.
-/

open Complex Real

namespace RHTower.HedenmalmThetaSource

noncomputable section

/-- Affine synthesis written in the opposite orientation of the same prime-two/prime-three frame. -/
def burnolSwappedAffineSynthesisFrame (c z : ℂ) : ℂ × ℂ :=
  (burnolCanonicalSynthesisCoefficient 3 z +
      c * burnolCompletedCenteredMultiplier 2 z,
    burnolCanonicalSynthesisCoefficient 2 z -
      c * burnolCompletedCenteredMultiplier 3 z)

theorem burnolSwappedAffineSynthesis_identity (c z : ℂ) :
    (burnolSwappedAffineSynthesisFrame c z).1 *
        burnolCompletedCenteredMultiplier 3 z +
      (burnolSwappedAffineSynthesisFrame c z).2 *
        burnolCompletedCenteredMultiplier 2 z = 1 := by
  rw [burnolSwappedAffineSynthesisFrame]
  dsimp only [Prod.fst, Prod.snd]
  rw [add_comm]
  rw [← burnolCanonicalSynthesis_identity z]
  ring

/-- Reversing frame orientation reverses the transverse affine gauge. -/
theorem burnolSwappedAffineSynthesisFrame_negGauge_swap (c z : ℂ) :
    burnolSwappedAffineSynthesisFrame (-c) z =
      ((burnolAffineSynthesisFrame c z).2,
        (burnolAffineSynthesisFrame c z).1) := by
  rw [burnolSwappedAffineSynthesisFrame, burnolAffineSynthesisFrame]
  apply Prod.ext <;> dsimp <;> ring

/-- Complete determinant-line transformation law: a swapped synthesis is the coordinate swap of
the original synthesis exactly when its transverse gauge changes sign. -/
theorem burnolSwappedAffineSynthesisFrame_swap_iff
    (cSwap c z : ℂ) :
    burnolSwappedAffineSynthesisFrame cSwap z =
        ((burnolAffineSynthesisFrame c z).2,
          (burnolAffineSynthesisFrame c z).1) ↔
      cSwap = -c := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have h2 := congrArg Prod.fst h
    have h3 := congrArg Prod.snd h
    simp only [burnolSwappedAffineSynthesisFrame,
      burnolAffineSynthesisFrame] at h2 h3
    have hp2 : (cSwap + c) * burnolCompletedCenteredMultiplier 2 z = 0 := by
      linear_combination h2
    have hp3 : (cSwap + c) * burnolCompletedCenteredMultiplier 3 z = 0 := by
      linear_combination -h3
    rcases burnol_completed_two_prime_no_common_zero z with ha2 | ha3
    · have hsum : cSwap + c = 0 :=
        (mul_eq_zero.mp hp2).resolve_right ha2
      linear_combination hsum
    · have hsum : cSwap + c = 0 :=
        (mul_eq_zero.mp hp3).resolve_right ha3
      linear_combination hsum
  · rintro rfl
    exact burnolSwappedAffineSynthesisFrame_negGauge_swap c z

/-- Treating the determinant-line gauge as an ordinary scalar makes swap covariance equivalent to
zero gauge. -/
theorem burnolSwappedAffineSynthesisFrame_sameGauge_swap_iff (c z : ℂ) :
    burnolSwappedAffineSynthesisFrame c z =
        ((burnolAffineSynthesisFrame c z).2,
          (burnolAffineSynthesisFrame c z).1) ↔
      c = 0 := by
  rw [burnolSwappedAffineSynthesisFrame_swap_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h
    linear_combination (1 / 2 : ℂ) * h
  · rintro rfl
    simp

/-- Gaussian/source splitting expressed after reversing the prime-frame orientation while keeping
the raw source number unchanged. -/
def thetaXiBurnolGaussianSwappedRawFrame (q : XiZeroCopy) : ℂ × ℂ :=
  burnolSwappedAffineSynthesisFrame

      (thetaXiBurnolGaussianSwappedRawFrame q).2 *

theorem thetaXiBurnolGaussianSwappedRaw_covariant_iff (q : XiZeroCopy) :

        ((thetaXiBurnolGaussianSynthesisFrame q).2,

/-!
# Route E parity-column circularity

For any finite row-stochastic kernel whose supported transitions reverse a sign, signed source
imbalance is exactly half the signed column-load defect.  Applied to the finite Möbius signature,
an all-strict-half bound for total column defect already implies RH by Littlewood's criterion.

Thus constructing an opposite-parity Route E kernel does not turn a strict-half column estimate
into an unsigned anti-concentration problem: that estimate itself contains the missing Möbius
cancellation.  Any surviving producer must control this signed defect before scalar column-load
normalization.
-/

open scoped ArithmeticFunction.Moebius BigOperators

namespace RHTower

noncomputable section

namespace FiniteRowStochasticKernel

variable {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]

/-- Incoming load at one column of a finite row-stochastic kernel. -/
def columnLoad (P : FiniteRowStochasticKernel ι ι) (j : ι) : ℝ :=
  ∑ i, P.weight i j

/-- **Exact parity-column law.**  A row-stochastic sign-reversing transport carries the signed
source imbalance into precisely half the signed defect of its column loads. -/
theorem two_mul_signedSum_eq_signedColumnDefect
    (P : FiniteRowStochasticKernel ι ι) (sign : ι → ℝ)
    (hflip : ∀ i j, P.weight i j ≠ 0 → sign i + sign j = 0) :
    2 * ∑ i, sign i = ∑ j, sign j * (1 - P.columnLoad j) := by
  have hterm (i j : ι) :
      sign i * P.weight i j = -sign j * P.weight i j := by
    by_cases hzero : P.weight i j = 0
    · simp [hzero]
    · have hsign : sign i = -sign j := by
        linarith [hflip i j hzero]
      rw [hsign]
  have htransport :
      (∑ i, sign i) = -∑ j, sign j * P.columnLoad j := by
    calc
      (∑ i, sign i) = ∑ i, sign i * ∑ j, P.weight i j := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _hi
        rw [P.row_sum i, mul_one]
      _ = ∑ i, ∑ j, sign i * P.weight i j := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _hi
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      _ = ∑ j, ∑ i, sign i * P.weight i j := Finset.sum_comm
      _ = ∑ j, ∑ i, -sign j * P.weight i j := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro j _hj
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _hi
        exact hterm i j
      _ = -∑ j, sign j * P.columnLoad j := by
        unfold columnLoad
        simp_rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
        rw [← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro j _hj
        ring
  have hright :
      (∑ j, sign j * (1 - P.columnLoad j)) =
        (∑ i, sign i) - ∑ j, sign j * P.columnLoad j := by
    simp_rw [mul_sub, mul_one, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  rw [hright]
  linarith

/-- Total absolute column defect bounds every unit-bounded signed source imbalance. -/
theorem abs_signedSum_le_half_columnDefect
    (P : FiniteRowStochasticKernel ι ι) (sign : ι → ℝ)
    (hsign : ∀ i, |sign i| ≤ 1)
    (hflip : ∀ i j, P.weight i j ≠ 0 → sign i + sign j = 0) :
    |∑ i, sign i| ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ j, |1 - P.columnLoad j| := by
  have hid := P.two_mul_signedSum_eq_signedColumnDefect sign hflip
  have habs :
      |2 * ∑ i, sign i| ≤ ∑ j, |1 - P.columnLoad j| := by
    rw [hid]
    calc
      |∑ j, sign j * (1 - P.columnLoad j)| ≤
          ∑ j, |sign j * (1 - P.columnLoad j)| :=
        Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ j, |1 - P.columnLoad j| := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro j _hj
        rw [abs_mul]
        simpa using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hsign j) (abs_nonneg _)
  rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)] at habs
  nlinarith

end FiniteRowStochasticKernel

/-- The Möbius signs on positive coordinates through `N` sum to the finite coprimality
signature. -/
theorem sum_finiteMobiusCoprimeCoordinate_mobius_eq_signature (N : ℕ) :
    (∑ i : finiteMobiusCoprimeCoordinate N, ((μ i.1 : ℤ) : ℝ)) =
      ((finiteMobiusCoprimeSignature N : ℤ) : ℝ) := by
  rw [finiteMobiusCoprimeSignature_eq_sum_Icc]
  push_cast
  simpa [finiteMobiusCoprimeCoordinate] using
    (Finset.sum_attach (Finset.Icc 1 N) (fun n => ((μ n : ℤ) : ℝ)))

/-- Route E's proposed strict-half total column-defect input, after retaining the literal Möbius
signs and requiring every supported edge to reverse them. -/
def RouteEParityColumnDefectAllStrictHalfPowerBound : Prop :=
  ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ N : ℕ, 2 ≤ N →
    ∃ P : FiniteRowStochasticKernel
        (finiteMobiusCoprimeCoordinate N) (finiteMobiusCoprimeCoordinate N),
      (∀ i j, P.weight i j ≠ 0 →
        ((μ i.1 : ℤ) : ℝ) + ((μ j.1 : ℤ) : ℝ) = 0) ∧
      (∑ j, |1 - P.columnLoad j|) ≤
        2 * C * ((N : ℝ) + 1) ^ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) + δ)

estimate.  Kernel construction supplies no independent cancellation. -/

# Reflection on an even positive weighted Hilbert space

For an even positive weight on the real line, pullback by `x ↦ -x` preserves the weighted
measure.  This module constructs the resulting unitary involution on weighted `L²` and records its
literal almost-everywhere action.  The construction is independent of any spectral route.

variable {w : ℝ → ℝ}

/-- Reflection preserves a measure with even real density. -/
theorem map_neg_positiveWeightedMeasure (hw : Measurable w)
    (heven : ∀ x, w (-x) = w x) :
    Measure.map (fun x : ℝ => -x)
        ((volume : Measure ℝ).withDensity (realDensity w)) =
      (volume : Measure ℝ).withDensity (realDensity w) := by
  rw [map_withDensity_of_involution measurable_neg (fun x => neg_neg x)
    (Measure.measurePreserving_neg (volume : Measure ℝ)).map_eq
    (measurable_realDensity hw)]
  congr 1
  funext x
  simp [realDensity, heven]

theorem measurePreserving_neg_positiveWeightedMeasure (hw : Measurable w)
    (heven : ∀ x, w (-x) = w x) :
    MeasurePreserving (fun x : ℝ => -x)
      ((volume : Measure ℝ).withDensity (realDensity w))
      ((volume : Measure ℝ).withDensity (realDensity w)) :=
  ⟨measurable_neg, map_neg_positiveWeightedMeasure hw heven⟩

/-- Pullback by reflection on an even positive weighted `L²` space. -/
def positiveWeightedReflection (hw : Measurable w)
    (heven : ∀ x, w (-x) = w x) :
    WeightedL2 (μ := volume) w →L[ℂ] WeightedL2 (μ := volume) w :=
  (Lp.compMeasurePreservingₗᵢ ℂ (fun x : ℝ => -x)
    (measurePreserving_neg_positiveWeightedMeasure hw heven)).toContinuousLinearMap

theorem positiveWeightedReflection_ae (hw : Measurable w) (hpos : ∀ x, 0 < w x)
    (heven : ∀ x, w (-x) = w x) (f : WeightedL2 (μ := volume) w) :
    positiveWeightedReflection hw heven f =ᵐ[(volume : Measure ℝ)] fun x => f (-x) := by
  apply (withDensity_realDensity_ae_eq hw hpos).mp
  exact Lp.coeFn_compMeasurePreserving f
    (measurePreserving_neg_positiveWeightedMeasure hw heven)

@[simp] theorem positiveWeightedReflection_involutive (hw : Measurable w)
    (heven : ∀ x, w (-x) = w x) (f : WeightedL2 (μ := volume) w) :
    positiveWeightedReflection hw heven (positiveWeightedReflection hw heven f) = f := by
  apply Lp.ext
  have hinner := (Lp.coeFn_compMeasurePreserving f
    (measurePreserving_neg_positiveWeightedMeasure hw heven)).comp_tendsto
      (measurePreserving_neg_positiveWeightedMeasure hw heven).quasiMeasurePreserving.tendsto_ae
  filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_compMeasurePreserving
      (positiveWeightedReflection hw heven f)
      (measurePreserving_neg_positiveWeightedMeasure hw heven), hinner] with x hout hin
  change ((Lp.compMeasurePreserving (fun x : ℝ => -x)
      (measurePreserving_neg_positiveWeightedMeasure hw heven)
      (positiveWeightedReflection hw heven f) : WeightedL2 (μ := volume) w) : ℝ → ℂ) x = f x
  rw [hout]
  change ((Lp.compMeasurePreserving (fun x : ℝ => -x)
      (measurePreserving_neg_positiveWeightedMeasure hw heven) f :
        WeightedL2 (μ := volume) w) : ℝ → ℂ) (-x) = f x
  simpa only [Function.comp_apply, neg_neg] using hin

theorem norm_positiveWeightedReflection (hw : Measurable w)
    (heven : ∀ x, w (-x) = w x) (f : WeightedL2 (μ := volume) w) :
    ‖positiveWeightedReflection hw heven f‖ = ‖f‖ :=
  (Lp.compMeasurePreservingₗᵢ ℂ (fun x : ℝ => -x)
    (measurePreserving_neg_positiveWeightedMeasure hw heven)).norm_map f

/-- Reflection as an onto linear isometry, with itself as inverse. -/
def positiveWeightedReflectionLIE (hw : Measurable w)
    (heven : ∀ x, w (-x) = w x) :
    WeightedL2 (μ := volume) w ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] WeightedL2 (μ := volume) w where
  __ := Lp.compMeasurePreservingₗᵢ ℂ (fun x : ℝ => -x)

  invFun := positiveWeightedReflection hw heven
  left_inv := positiveWeightedReflection_involutive hw heven
  right_inv := positiveWeightedReflection_involutive hw heven

@[simp] theorem positiveWeightedReflectionLIE_apply (hw : Measurable w)
    (heven : ∀ x, w (-x) = w x) (f : WeightedL2 (μ := volume) w) :
    positiveWeightedReflectionLIE hw heven f = positiveWeightedReflection hw heven f := rfl

/-!
# Continuity of Real conjugation on Meyer's strong logarithmic target

Complex conjugation commutes with every iterated real derivative and sends
each weighted uniform gauge to pointwise conjugation of that gauge.  Hence the
Real involution is continuous for the full all-derivative,
all-exponential-weight topology.
-/

noncomputable section

open Complex Filter Function Set Topology
open scoped BoundedContinuousFunction ContDiff

namespace RHTower

/-- Complex conjugation commutes with every iterated real derivative of a
smooth complex-valued function. -/
theorem iteratedDeriv_complexConj_strongLog :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) {g : ℝ → ℂ}, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) g →
      iteratedDeriv n (fun x => star (g x)) =
        fun x => star (iteratedDeriv n g x) := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      intro g hg
      simp
  | succ n ihn =>
      intro g hg
      rw [iteratedDeriv_succ, iteratedDeriv_succ, ihn hg]
      funext x
      have hdiff : DifferentiableAt ℝ (iteratedDeriv n g) x := by
        have h := hg.differentiable_iteratedDeriv n
          (compareOfLessAndEq_eq_lt.mp rfl)
        exact h.differentiableAt
      exact ((Complex.conjCLE.hasFDerivAt).comp_hasDerivAt
        x hdiff.hasDerivAt).deriv

/-- Conjugation as a conjugate-linear involution of the radial strong space. -/
def deningerMeyerStrongLogConjₛₗ :
    DeningerMeyerStrongLogTarget →ₗ⋆[ℂ] DeningerMeyerStrongLogTarget where
  toFun := deningerMeyerStrongLogConj
  map_add' := deningerMeyerStrongLogConj_add
  map_smul' := deningerMeyerStrongLogConj_smul

/-- Every defining gauge intertwines radial Real conjugation with pointwise
conjugation in the bounded-function recipient. -/
theorem deningerMeyerStrongLogGauge_conj
    (n : ℕ) (k : ℤ) (g : DeningerMeyerStrongLogTarget) :
    deningerMeyerStrongLogGauge n k (deningerMeyerStrongLogConj g) =
      star (deningerMeyerStrongLogGauge n k g) := by
  apply BoundedContinuousFunction.ext
  intro t
  rw [deningerMeyerStrongLogGauge_apply]
  change ((Real.exp t ^ (k : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
      iteratedDeriv n
        (deningerMeyerStrongLogConj g : DeningerMeyerStrongLogTarget) t =
    star (deningerMeyerStrongLogGauge n k g t)
  have hfun :
      ((deningerMeyerStrongLogConj g : DeningerMeyerStrongLogTarget) :
          ℝ → ℂ) = fun x => star ((g : ℝ → ℂ) x) :=
    rfl
  rw [deningerMeyerStrongLogGauge_apply, hfun,
    iteratedDeriv_complexConj_strongLog n g.property.smooth]
  change ((Real.exp t ^ (k : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
      star (iteratedDeriv n (g : ℝ → ℂ) t) =
    star (((Real.exp t ^ (k : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
      iteratedDeriv n (g : ℝ → ℂ) t)
  have hweight :
      star (((Real.exp t ^ (k : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
        (((Real.exp t ^ (k : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)) := by
    exact Complex.conj_ofReal _
  rw [star_mul, hweight, mul_comm]

/-- Radial Real conjugation is continuous for Meyer's natural strong
weighted-derivative topology. -/
theorem deningerMeyerStrongLogConj_continuous :

The no-go modules rule out several tempting detectors: Landau positivity is a
real-axis shadow, the pinned joint symmetry has exponent two, and finite

records the positive mathematical content left by those failures.

The point is not to replace the no-go results.  It packages them as reusable
positive statements:

* the RH axis is the functional-equation line reflection, not conjugation;
* an odd strip zero activates a concrete finite Euler-Maclaurin certificate;
* pinned prime-local sigma sources are exhausted, so divisor content must be
  global/seam-level rather than finite-prime-local.

open Complex Finset Polynomial Metric Set

/-! ### Generic fixed-locus parity -/

/-- **Fixed-locus parity for any finite involution.**  If a finite weighted
configuration is preserved by an involution, then the parity of the total
weight is the parity of the weight on the fixed locus.  Every free two-point
orbit contributes twice and disappears modulo two.

This is the abstract form shared by the conjugation shadow and the
critical-line reflection shadow. -/
theorem involution_fixed_locus_parity {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]
    (s : Finset ι) (m : ι → ℕ) (σf : ι → ι)
    (hσmem : ∀ i ∈ s, σf i ∈ s)
    (hσm : ∀ i ∈ s, m (σf i) = m i)
    (hσinv : ∀ i ∈ s, σf (σf i) = i) :
    ((-1 : ℂ)) ^ (∑ i ∈ s, m i)
      = (-1) ^ (∑ i ∈ s.filter (fun i => σf i = i), m i) := by
  classical
  rw [← Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not s (fun i => σf i = i) m]
  have heven : Even (∑ i ∈ s.filter (fun i => ¬σf i = i), m i) := by
    rw [even_iff_two_dvd,
      ← ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff (∑ i ∈ s.filter (fun i => ¬σf i = i), m i) 2]
    push_cast
    refine Finset.sum_involution (fun i _ => σf i) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · intro i hi
      obtain ⟨his, -⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hi
      show (m i : ZMod 2) + (m (σf i) : ZMod 2) = 0
      rw [hσm i his]
      exact CharTwo.add_self_eq_zero _
    · intro i hi _ hfix
      exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2 hfix
    · intro i hi
      obtain ⟨his, hnot⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hi
      show σf i ∈ s.filter (fun i => ¬σf i = i)
      rw [Finset.mem_filter]
      refine ⟨hσmem i his, ?_⟩
      intro hfix
      apply hnot
      calc
        σf i = σf (σf i) := hfix.symm
        _ = i := hσinv i his
    · intro i hi
      exact hσinv i (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).1
  rw [pow_add, heven.neg_one_pow, mul_one]

/-! ### Axis selection: Landau sees the real axis; FE sees the critical line -/

/-- **Landau's positive content:** the conjugation/Landau shadow selects exactly
the real-axis part of a conjugation-equivariant configuration. -/
theorem landau_shadow_selects_real_axis {ι : Type*}
    (s : Finset ι) (ρc : ι → ℂ) (m : ι → ℕ) (σf : ι → ι)
    (hσmem : ∀ i ∈ s, σf i ∈ s)
    (hσρ : ∀ i ∈ s, ρc (σf i) = (starRingEnd ℂ) (ρc i))
    (hσm : ∀ i ∈ s, m (σf i) = m i)
    (hσinv : ∀ i ∈ s, σf (σf i) = i) :
    ((-1 : ℂ)) ^ (∑ i ∈ s, m i)
      = (-1) ^ (∑ i ∈ s.filter (fun i => (ρc i).im = 0), m i) :=
  conj_equivariant_parity s ρc m σf hσmem hσρ hσm hσinv

/-- **The RH-axis positive content:** the functional-equation line-reflection
shadow selects exactly the critical-line part of a reflection-equivariant
configuration. -/
theorem fe_shadow_selects_critical_line {ι : Type*}
    (s : Finset ι) (ρc : ι → ℂ) (m : ι → ℕ) (σf : ι → ι)
    (hσmem : ∀ i ∈ s, σf i ∈ s)
    (hσρ : ∀ i ∈ s, ρc (σf i) = lineReflection (1 / 2) (ρc i))
    (hσm : ∀ i ∈ s, m (σf i) = m i)
    (hσinv : ∀ i ∈ s, σf (σf i) = i) :
    ((-1 : ℂ)) ^ (∑ i ∈ s, m i)
      = (-1) ^ (∑ i ∈ s.filter (fun i => (ρc i).re = 1 / 2), m i) :=
  neg_one_pow_sum_reflection_equivariant s ρc m σf hσmem hσρ hσm hσinv

/-- **Axis separation, stated positively.**  For one finite configuration
carrying both involutions and no real-axis points, Landau's shadow is trivial
while the FE shadow is the critical-line count. -/
theorem landau_fe_axis_separation {ι : Type*}
    (s : Finset ι) (ρc : ι → ℂ) (m : ι → ℕ) (σc σℓ : ι → ι)
    (hσcmem : ∀ i ∈ s, σc i ∈ s)
    (hσcρ : ∀ i ∈ s, ρc (σc i) = (starRingEnd ℂ) (ρc i))
    (hσcm : ∀ i ∈ s, m (σc i) = m i)
    (hσcinv : ∀ i ∈ s, σc (σc i) = i)
    (hσℓmem : ∀ i ∈ s, σℓ i ∈ s)
    (hσℓρ : ∀ i ∈ s, ρc (σℓ i) = lineReflection (1 / 2) (ρc i))
    (hσℓm : ∀ i ∈ s, m (σℓ i) = m i)
    (hσℓinv : ∀ i ∈ s, σℓ (σℓ i) = i)
    (hoff : ∀ i ∈ s, (ρc i).im ≠ 0) :
    (((-1 : ℂ)) ^ (∑ i ∈ s, m i) = 1) ∧
      (((-1 : ℂ)) ^ (∑ i ∈ s, m i)
        = (-1) ^ (∑ i ∈ s.filter (fun i => (ρc i).re = 1 / 2), m i)) :=
  landau_conj_shadow_vs_fe_line_shadow s ρc m σc σℓ

/-
Weighted charge parity for reflected saddle/grid collisions.

`ReflectedGridParity` shows that the unit collision count has one possible odd source:
the square fixed point of the divisor-antidiagonal reflection.  Physical event charge is
weighted, not just counted.  This file proves the weighted statement the reflection route
needs: if the charge is invariant under factor-swap reflection and the fixed diagonal charge
is even, then the total reflected grid charge is even.  Equivalently, the deck reduction at
level two is trivial.
-/
import GaloisForLFunctions.RHTower.ReflectedGridParity

open Complex Real
open scoped BigOperators

namespace RHTower

/-- The weighted charge of the reflected saddle/grid collision carrier. -/
def reflectedGridWeightedCharge (C : ℕ) (q : ℕ × ℕ → ℕ) : ℕ :=
  ∑ x ∈ reflectedGridCollisions C, q x

/-- **Weighted reflected collision parity.**  If the collision weight is invariant under the
factor-swap reflection and every fixed diagonal collision carries even weight, then the total
reflected grid charge is even. -/
theorem reflectedGridWeightedCharge_even_of_swap_invariant_even_fixed {C : ℕ}
    {q : ℕ × ℕ → ℕ}
    (hsym : ∀ x ∈ reflectedGridCollisions C, q (reflectedGridSwap x) = q x)
    (hfixed : ∀ x ∈ reflectedGridCollisions C, x.1 = x.2 → Even (q x)) :
    Even (reflectedGridWeightedCharge C q) := by
  unfold reflectedGridWeightedCharge
  let p : ℕ × ℕ → Prop := fun x => x.1 = x.2
  have hdiag : Even (∑ x ∈ (reflectedGridCollisions C).filter p, q x) := by
    rw [even_iff_two_dvd]
    refine Finset.dvd_sum (s := (reflectedGridCollisions C).filter p) (f := q) (a := 2) ?_
    intro x hx
    rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hx
    exact (hfixed x hx.1 hx.2).two_dvd
  have hnon : Even (∑ x ∈ (reflectedGridCollisions C).filter (fun x => ¬ p x), q x) := by
    apply even_sum_of_fpf_involution
      ((reflectedGridCollisions C).filter fun x : ℕ × ℕ => ¬ p x)
      (fun x : ℕ × ℕ => reflectedGridSwap x) q
    · intro x hx
      rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hx ⊢
      refine ⟨reflectedGridSwap_mem hx.1, ?_⟩
      intro h
      apply hx.2
      simpa [p, reflectedGridSwap] using h.symm
    · intro x hx
      exact reflectedGridSwap_involutive x
    · intro x hx hfix
      rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hx
      have h21 : x.2 = x.1 := congrArg Prod.fst hfix
      exact hx.2 h21.symm
    · intro x hx
      rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hx
      exact hsym x hx.1
  have hsplit := Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not (reflectedGridCollisions C) p q
  rw [← hsplit]
  exact hdiag.add hnon

/-- The weighted reflected grid charge is invisible to the level-two deck reduction under
the same reflection-invariant/even-fixed hypotheses. -/
theorem reflectedGridWeightedCharge_deckRed_two_eq_one_of_swap_invariant_even_fixed {C : ℕ}
    {q : ℕ × ℕ → ℕ}
    (hsym : ∀ x ∈ reflectedGridCollisions C, q (reflectedGridSwap x) = q x)
    (hfixed : ∀ x ∈ reflectedGridCollisions C, x.1 = x.2 → Even (q x)) :
    deckRed 2 (↑(reflectedGridWeightedCharge C q)) = 1 := by
  rw [deckRed_two_eq_one_iff]
  exact_mod_cast reflectedGridWeightedCharge_even_of_swap_invariant_even_fixed hsym hfixed

/-- If the normalized height has no positive square fixed point, swap-invariance alone makes
the weighted reflected grid charge even. -/
theorem reflectedGridWeightedCharge_even_of_swap_invariant_no_fixed {C : ℕ}
    {q : ℕ × ℕ → ℕ}
    (hsym : ∀ x ∈ reflectedGridCollisions C, q (reflectedGridSwap x) = q x)
    (hnsq : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → n * n ≠ C) :
    Even (reflectedGridWeightedCharge C q) := by
  apply reflectedGridWeightedCharge_even_of_swap_invariant_even_fixed hsym
  intro x hx hdiag
  rw [reflectedGridCollision_mem_iff] at hx
  have hsquare : x.1 * x.1 = C := by simpa [hdiag] using hx.1
  have hpos : 0 < x.1 := by
    by_contra hnot
    have hz : x.1 = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos hnot
    rw [hz] at hsquare
    simp at hsquare
    exact hx.2 hsquare.symm
  exact False.elim (hnsq x.1 hpos hsquare)

/-- No positive square fixed point makes the weighted reflected grid charge deck-trivial at
level two. -/
theorem reflectedGridWeightedCharge_deckRed_two_eq_one_of_swap_invariant_no_fixed {C : ℕ}
    {q : ℕ × ℕ → ℕ}
    (hsym : ∀ x ∈ reflectedGridCollisions C, q (reflectedGridSwap x) = q x)
    (hnsq : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → n * n ≠ C) :
    deckRed 2 (↑(reflectedGridWeightedCharge C q)) = 1 := by
  rw [deckRed_two_eq_one_iff]
  exact_mod_cast reflectedGridWeightedCharge_even_of_swap_invariant_no_fixed hsym hnsq

/-- If `C=r²`, it is enough to prove that the single square fixed-point charge is even. -/
theorem reflectedGridWeightedCharge_even_of_swap_invariant_square_fixed_even {C r : ℕ}
    {q : ℕ × ℕ → ℕ} (hrpos : 0 < r) (hr : r * r = C)
    (hsym : ∀ x ∈ reflectedGridCollisions C, q (reflectedGridSwap x) = q x)
    (hrfixed : Even (q (r, r))) :
    Even (reflectedGridWeightedCharge C q) := by
  apply reflectedGridWeightedCharge_even_of_swap_invariant_even_fixed hsym
  intro x hx hdiag

/-!
# A universal split Krein reflection receives every source-horizontal packet

The earlier capacity theorems force any bounded involutive all-packet reflection to retain two
noncompact essential sectors. This file proves that boundary sharp for the literal shared
HB/FZZ-P/PW-B/RBH source family.

Take the fixed carrier `ℓ²(ℕ, ℝ) ⊕ ℓ²(ℕ, ℝ)`, the split form

`Q(u,v) = ‖u‖² - ‖v‖²`,

and the bounded involution swapping the two sectors. Every weighted reservoir packet has the exact
factorization

`Σᵢ yᵢ² - (Σᵢ yᵢ)²`,  where `yᵢ = sqrt(wᵢ) xᵢ`.

Its first term is embedded in finitely many coordinates of the first `ℓ²` sector and its sum in one
coordinate of the second. Sector swap negates the form and therefore realizes FE reflection.
For a right-half-plane copy the initial embedding is swapped once.

Thus the same fixed bounded involutive carrier receives every packet of every hypothetical
off-wall Xi copy. Abstract quadratic capacity, infinite index, essential bipolarity, and bounded
linear reflection existence are therefore nonselective: none can supply the missing shared Ward
orientation. Any surviving proof must use source-semantic phase, causal Schwarz oddness, a fixed
Ward law, or nonlinear/singular/domain-changing structure.

The ambient split-Krein construction is classical. The new result is its exact sharpness theorem
for the literal four-route source family and the resulting route-class kill.

`[NEW] [SHARED-WARD ROUTE-CLASS KILL] [SHARPNESS] [UNIVERSAL SPLIT KREIN]`
-/

open scoped BigOperators InnerProductSpace ENNReal

namespace RHTower

/-- Real square-summable sequences used for each essential orientation sector. -/
abbrev SourceHorizontalSplitL2 : Type :=
  lp (fun _ : ℕ => ℝ) 2

/-- Fixed two-sector carrier, independent of the Xi copy and packet size. -/
abbrev SourceHorizontalSplitKreinCarrier : Type :=
  SourceHorizontalSplitL2 × SourceHorizontalSplitL2

/-- Polar form of the standard split quadratic form. -/
def sourceHorizontalSplitKreinBilin :
    LinearMap.BilinMap ℝ SourceHorizontalSplitKreinCarrier ℝ :=
  LinearMap.mk₂ ℝ
    (fun x y => inner ℝ x.1 y.1 - inner ℝ x.2 y.2)
    (by intro x y z; simp [inner_add_left]; ring)
    (by intro c x y; simp [real_inner_smul_left]; ring)
    (by intro x y z; simp [inner_add_right]; ring)
    (by intro c x y; simp [real_inner_smul_right]; ring)

/-- Standard infinite-index split quadratic form. -/
def sourceHorizontalSplitKreinForm :
    QuadraticForm ℝ SourceHorizontalSplitKreinCarrier :=
  sourceHorizontalSplitKreinBilin.toQuadraticMap

/-- Bounded sector exchange; it negates the split form. -/
def sourceHorizontalSplitSwap :
    SourceHorizontalSplitKreinCarrier →L[ℝ]
      SourceHorizontalSplitKreinCarrier :=
  (ContinuousLinearEquiv.prodComm ℝ SourceHorizontalSplitL2
    SourceHorizontalSplitL2).toContinuousLinearMap

@[simp] theorem sourceHorizontalSplitSwap_apply
    (x : SourceHorizontalSplitKreinCarrier) :
    sourceHorizontalSplitSwap x = (x.2, x.1) := rfl

@[simp] theorem sourceHorizontalSplitKreinForm_apply
    (x : SourceHorizontalSplitKreinCarrier) :
    sourceHorizontalSplitKreinForm x =
      inner ℝ x.1 x.1 - inner ℝ x.2 x.2 := rfl

/-- Sector exchange is an anti-isometry of the split quadratic form. -/
theorem sourceHorizontalSplitKreinForm_swap
    (x : SourceHorizontalSplitKreinCarrier) :
    sourceHorizontalSplitKreinForm (sourceHorizontalSplitSwap x) =
      -sourceHorizontalSplitKreinForm x := by
  simp [sourceHorizontalSplitKreinForm_apply]

/-- Sector exchange is an involution. -/
theorem sourceHorizontalSplitSwap_involutive :
    sourceHorizontalSplitSwap * sourceHorizontalSplitSwap = 1 := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro x
  rfl

/-- Single-coordinate inclusion into real `ℓ²`. -/
def sourceHorizontalLpSingle (n : ℕ) :
    ℝ →ₗ[ℝ] SourceHorizontalSplitL2 where
  toFun a := lp.single 2 n a
  map_add' a b := by
    ext k
    by_cases h : k = n <;> simp [lp.single_apply, h]
  map_smul' c a := by
    ext k
    by_cases h : k = n <;> simp [lp.single_apply, h]

/-- The weighted `i`-th packet coordinate. -/
def sourceHorizontalPacketCoordinate {m : ℕ} (w : Fin m → ℝ)
    (i : Fin m) : (Fin m → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ where
  toFun x := Real.sqrt (w i) * x i
  map_add' x y := by simp [mul_add]
  map_smul' c x := by simp; ring

/-- Embed all weighted packet coordinates in distinct `ℓ²` coordinates. -/
def sourceHorizontalPacketSynthesis {m : ℕ} (w : Fin m → ℝ) :
    (Fin m → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] SourceHorizontalSplitL2 :=
  ∑ i : Fin m,
    (sourceHorizontalLpSingle (i : ℕ)).comp
      (sourceHorizontalPacketCoordinate w i)

/-- Put the shared-reservoir sum in one coordinate of the opposite sector. -/
def sourceHorizontalPacketAnchor {m : ℕ} (w : Fin m → ℝ) :
    (Fin m → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] SourceHorizontalSplitL2 :=
  (sourceHorizontalLpSingle 0).comp
